name: read exactly 16 bytes from wasm linear memory at a dynamic offset
definition: Expose and slice the module's exported memory to fetch a fixed-length buffer starting at the offset returned by the producer function.
failure_mode: Wrong length or wrong offset yields incorrect bytes and a wrong final integer.

name: regenerate and run an executable from the emitted IR to validate it
definition: Assemble the IR to an object, link it against the project's shared libraries, and confirm the resulting binary executes as expected.
failure_mode: IR inconsistent with shared lib or missing expected behavior
